original.question: Dax akaenda kumunda chirimwa kutora mamwe maapuro uye akawana hafu ye hanzi se hanzi mum munda. Kana paine 50 hanzi, bwerera huwandu hwehanzi pamwe mum munda.
original.answer:
Kana paine 50 hanzi, huwandu hwe hanzi mum munda huri 1/2*50 hanzi = 25 hanzi
Huwandu hwehanzi pamwe mum munda huri 25 hanzi + 50 hanzi = <<25+50=75>>75 hanzi
